label: Show settings for *Pick one part at a time, or Everything. Settings keep their values while hidden.*

Icon set *Zen's own keeps Zen's icons, or New Icons' if that mod is installed, and moves each to a pose of its own on hover: reload turns, back slides left, downloads drop. Circuit is high-tech glass: chamfered shapes with every corner rounded, a translucent body with a sheen and rim, and neon-tube lines, drawn and animated frame by frame. Either way, motion builds up, overshoots and settles, and plays back when the pointer leaves. Each button can differ from the set under Each button.*
Animate icons *On: icons, Zen's own or Circuit, play their motion while hovered and play it back when the pointer leaves. Off: every icon stays still.*
Glow on hover *Animated icons, Zen's own and Circuit, glow softly in their own colour while hovered. Zen's own light up as they move.*
Glow flares when clicked *Any icon Iconflow covers glows bigger and brighter while pressed.*
Icons press in when clicked *The icon shrinks while held and springs back on release. Works with or without the flare.*
Soft glow around lines *Circuit's neon lines carry a faint halo. Off draws crisp lines only.*
Only while hovered *The halo fades in when you point at a button and out when you leave.*

Animate menu icons *Icons in context menus and other menus (Zen's, or those Context Menu Icons adds) play a short motion when highlighted. Items that do what a toolbar button does move the same way, such as Back, Reload or Bookmark; the rest pop gently. Works with any icon set. Uses Animation speed.*

Glass plates *A glass plate behind sidebar and toolbar buttons, made like Glassflow's window buttons: a light fill, a sheen across the top and a rim, over Zen's own blur. With Glassflow installed it uses Glassflow's own sheen and rim, so they follow its Glass settings.*
*Follow the icon set, or pick for one button. Circuit, still shows the Circuit icon without its animation.*
Reload style *Orbit pair has two glass diamonds circling the arc at different speeds. Twin comets sends two comets opposite ways, nearly meeting at the end. Both trail while moving fast.*
*Buttons you can add under Customise toolbar.*
*Movement of the whole icon while hovered, with any icon set. Leave as it is keeps Zen's or another mod's own (Arc spins the + at the bottom of the sidebar). None stops it.*
Motion speed *Arc's spin of the + takes 0.25 seconds.*

Library button icon *The button at the bottom of the sidebar that opens downloads and the Library. Follow the icon set shows Zen's with Zen's own set and Circuit stack with Circuit. The line shapes play with Zen's own hover animation.*

options.label: Hex scan: a line sweeps a hexagon
Focus: brackets close on a dot
Grid: a tile lifts out and turns
Orbit: a ring swings round a core
Circuit stack: glass plates pull apart

label: Same size as the other buttons *Zen draws it 18px and 8% larger; the other buttons are 16px.*
*The New Tab button above the tabs. Replaces Better New Tab button. Tab and folder roundness are in Glassflow and Groupflow.*
Hide the New Tab text *Shows only the +.*
Press effect *The button shrinks slightly while pressed.*
Even spacing around the button *Room below it when the pinned-tabs separator shows, and above the separator when it does not.*
